$source: Codex SNMPv3 onboarding (7 PNET IOSv hosts): itemids supplied directly by the operator on 2026-10-04. Live-verifying history/trend values from this environment requires an operator-role Zabbix API user; the installed service user `nbzsync` is restricted to host.get only, so item.get / history.get / trend.get all return "No permissions" here. These bindings are the production bindings used by the live-rendering widget when a logged-in operator opens the NOC wall.

$supplemental.note: PNET-INT-CORE Gi0/0 TO-STC (in=51710, out=51722) is deliberately not shown on the 6-slot wall; it mirrors slot 1 at the other end of the same link. Keep it available for the Edit Wall picker.
